requirements.text: Measure consecutive segments rather than distinct values globally.
Exclude every repeated value from the current segment.
Move the left boundary forward without losing valid overlapping segments.
Handle singleton, signed, all-equal, and all-distinct inputs.

time_by_phase.Sliding window: Expected O(N) with a hash table

reference_complexity.notes: Reference targets describe an algorithm, not the submitted program. Include stored input/output and recursion stacks when reviewing total space. Tokenized input and buffered output in some language references consume additional space. Hash-table bounds, where stated, are expected rather than worst-case guarantees. Difficulty and duration are provisional estimates for university DSA students.
